It's an Act of the Parliament of India enacted on 4 August 2009. It describes modalities of importance of free and compulsory education for children between age 6 to 14 in India under Article 21A of Indian Constitution. India became one of 135 countries to make education a fundamental right of every child when the act came into force on 1 April 2010. The title incorporates words "free and compulsory". Definition of compulsory education: obligation on appropriate Government and local authorities to provide and ensure admission, attendance and completion of elementary education by all children in 6-14 age group.
